name: Sikadur®-30
tagline: Thixotropic self-priming epoxy adhesive for structural strengthening using CFRP laminates and steel plate bonding
summary: Sikadur®-30 is a thixotropic, structural 2-component adhesive, based on a combination of epoxy resins and special filler, designed for use at normal temperatures between +8 °C and +35 °C.
metaDescription: Sikadur®-30 is a thixotropic, structural 2-component adhesive, based on a combination of epoxy resins and special filler, designed for use at normal temperatures between +8 °C and +35 °C.
attributes: No primer needed. Self Priming adhesive saving time on installation.
High creep resistance under permanent load.
Very good adhesion to concrete, masonry, stonework, steel, cast iron, aluminium, timber and Sika® CarboDur® Plates.
Hardening is not affected by high humidity.
Thixotropic: non-sag in vertical and overhead applications.
High initial and ultimate mechanical resistance.
Impermeable to liquids and water vapour.
usage: Adhesive for bonding structural reinforcement, particularly in structural strengthening works. Especially for the following uses:

Sika® CarboDur® Plates to concrete, brickwork and timber (for details see the Sika® CarboDur® Product Data Sheet, the “Method Statement for Sika® CarboDur® Externally Bonded Reinforcement” Ref: 850 41 05 and the “Method Statement for Sika® CarboDur® Near Surface Mounted Reinforcement” Ref: 850 41 07).
Steel plates to concrete (for details see the relevant Sika Technical information).
advantages: No primer needed. Self Priming adhesive saving time on installation.
High creep resistance under permanent load.
Very good adhesion to concrete, masonry, stonework, steel, cast iron, aluminium, timber and Sika® CarboDur® Plates.
Hardening is not affected by high humidity.
Thixotropic: non-sag in vertical and overhead applications.
High initial and ultimate mechanical resistance.
Impermeable to liquids and water vapour.

items.label: Material temperature

items.label: Ambient air temperature

items.label: Dew point

items.label: Substrate temperature
items.text: +8 °C min. / +35 °C max.

items.label: Substrate moisture content
items.text: Max. 4 % pbw When applied to mat damp concrete, brush the adhesive well into the substrate.

items.label: Pot Life
items.text:
Temperature | Potlife | Open time
+8 °C | ~120 minutes | ~150 minutes
+20 °C | ~90 minutes | ~110 minuets
+35 °C | ~20 minutes | ~50 minutes
The potlife begins when the resin and hardener are mixed. It is shorter at high temperatures and longer at low temperatures. The greater the quantity mixed, the shorter the potlife. To obtain longer workability at high temperatures, the mixed adhesive may be divided into portions. Another method is to chill components A+B before mixing them (not below +5 °C).

items.label: SUBSTRATE QUALITY
items.text: See the Product Data Sheet of Sika® CarboDur® Plates and Sika® CarboDur® BC rods.

items.label: SUBSTRATE PREPARATION
items.text: See the “Method Statement for Sika® CarboDur® Externally Bonded Reinforcement” Ref: 850 41 05 and the “Method Statement for Sika® CarboDur® Near Surface Mounted Reinforcement” Ref: 850 41 07.

items.label: MIXING
items.text: Pre-batched units: Mix componentss A+B together for at least 3 minutes with a mixing spindle attached to a slow speed electric drill (max. 300 rpm) until the material becomes smooth in consistency and a uniform grey colour. Avoid aeration while mixing. Then, pour the whole mix into a clean container and stir again for approx. 1 more minute at low speed to keep air entrapment at a minimum. Mix only that quantity which can be used within its potlife. Bulk packing, not pre-batched: First, stir each component thoroughly. Add the components in the correct proportions into a suitable mixing pail and stir correctly using an electric low speed mixer as above for pre-batched units.

items.label: CLEANING OF EQUIPMENT
items.text: Clean all tools and application equipment with Sika® Colma Cleaner immediately after use. Hardened / cured material can only be removed mechanically.
